title: the best way to take care of yourself when nothing seems to be worth doing
body: i'm clinically depressed. taking care of myself on even the most basic of levels can get hard very frequently. gamification helps sometimes. but what this app does that sets it apart from my usual methods to get things done, is that it gives you enough flexibility to work around your goals without making you feel guilty for not achieving them. + it has cute birds (my favorite animal) and great graphics and customization options, which renders the whole thing so much more enjoyable than regular self-care apps/methods. it truly helps on a deeper level than just the achievement of the goals themselves ; it helps to actually feel better. on a side note, being bisexual and non-binary, i think it's adorable that the devs thought of adding lgbt+ representation in such a casual and natural way.
